signs.Aries: The energy of the day may encourage you and your partner to start competing in a healthy manner. Try making positive suggestions about how you would like to see the future shaping up and see if you can envisage something together that makes you both excited. The whole point is to realize that you are responsible for your experience, so start creating what you want!
signs.Taurus: You may have a wonderful plan that you would love to share wholeheartedly with your sweetie pie. Only, you already know what their reaction is going to be. Most likely their response will be to pick holes in your new project until you are ready to just give up. Use the sense of conflict created to determine that, instead, you are going to make a great success of it.
signs.Gemini: A difference of opinion may arise between you and your loved one. However, you dislike conflict in general, and on such occasions tend to draw back into your shell, maintaining a stony silence. It may be better in this instance to say your piece, even though you hate to disagree. It is better to be true to yourself than not to bother.
signs.Cancer: If you are seeking that very special person, don't look for them in obvious places. You may well meet them at an online competitive game or while playing some kind of sport yourself. Perhaps while on the track, in the gym (if possible), or even in the pool, someone notices you as endorphins shirt into overdrive, and life takes on a rosy glow!
signs.Leo: You may feel encouraged to speak out a little more strongly than you have done of late. If you are not happy about a certain reoccurring situation, then the extra courage you feel will give you the ability to say so, and in no uncertain terms. You need to remember how you did this and use this strength more often.
signs.Virgo: You tend to compete in a really non-obvious, unassertive way. Today it is quite clear that you do need to attempt to be more vehement concerning your complaints procedure. Your lover has probably become used to the idea that you are easily persuaded. You need to show that you do have a mind of your own, and that you intend to use it.
signs.Libra: Some interesting competition could arise between you and your friends. There is a good chance that a few of you want to date the same person, so how will you cope with this? You will need to use all of your seductive charm, and the full power of those intensely dark and intelligent eyes. You know you'll win but competing makes the process even spicier.
signs.Scorpio: A bit of conflict never did anyone any harm, and that is why you will be happy for the dispute that suddenly brings a bit of life to a relationship on the point of extinction. Having something to argue about, even if it is only the price of meat, can keep a partnership alive in some instances. Today be grateful for your differences.
signs.Sagittarius: You may need to alter your tactics somewhat. You usually underplay your attempts at finding a suitable mate. You prefer to think that if someone hasn't noticed your superior charm, and aren't already thinking about proposing to you, then they aren't worth the effort. Now suddenly it's you who wants to do the chasing and will really enjoy the feeling of being in pursuit.
signs.Capricorn: Your partner may be feeling a little devilish. They want to see that look on your face when they ask you to commit and realize that this is one of the worst things you could be forced to contemplate. But the truth is that others need loyalty to feel secure, even if your only response is to run to the nearest escape hatch.
signs.Aquarius: You may be forced into doing something about your relationship. Normally you love to lie around while your lover gets things done because you feel far too lazy to even think of doing anything yourself. However, for once you are positively active, a sight that may cause your partner to wonder if you are not someone else in disguise. Prove today you have what it takes!
signs.Pisces: If you can settle any differences by straight talking, then this would be the best course of action. However, this may not work today, only because you feel duty bound to reiterate your point in a rather forceful way. The more your partner refuses to see it, the more you try to drive it home. Give it and them a rest!
